title: Respecting what a composer wrote, and why he dislikes rock and roll
summary: Randolph objects to others reshaping a composer's number and says he is just one man in disliking rock and roll for its structure.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future
